subject: where can I download the raw data?

messages.author: 626730cd55a308d2
messages.subject: where can I download the raw data?
parts:
Hi, Dr. Henrik Bengtsson,
 
  I want to make a try of aroma.affymetrix.  I install the package with Windows but can't find the following test data in the lib folder. I am wondering where can I find them
http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/total-copy-number-analysis-6-0 
 
Raw data:   Test set: HapMap270,6.0,CEU,testSet
Annotation data:  GenomeWideSNP_6,Full.cdf
 
  Thanks!
 
  Yue Hu

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] where can I download the raw data?
parts:
Hi,

the aroma.affymetrix package does not contain any data sets. Just
those six CEL files for the vignette you referring to sum to more than
400 MB, i.e. downloading example data with the each package
installation/update is not feasible.

The data files are available from Affymetrix. You'll find links on
the "GenomeWideSNP_6" chip type page:

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/total-copy-number-analysis-6-0

FYI, we try to collect links to known public data sets under the
corresponding chip type page under Section " Documentation on chip
types" (see "Pages").

Cheers

Henrik

Hi,
 
I found the annotation file.  Thanks a lot for your help.  I meet one problem:
 
>  cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType("GenomewideSNP_6", tags="Full")
 
give an error message.  "Exception: Could not create AffymetrixCdfFile object. No CDF file with that chip type found: GenomewideSNP_6"
 
I made folders under subdirectory of aroma.affymetrix package of R and put raw data in \rawData\
test\GenomewideSNP_6; put 3 annotation files in \annotationData\chipTypes\GenomeWideSNP_6, should I put the files in else place? (I have changed the annotation file name into GenomeWideSNP_6,Full.cdf)
 
Thank you very much.
 
 Yue

Hi,

I think that if you follow my troubleshooting suggesting in one of the
last messages of the recent thread 'problems with annotation file
directory path Options':

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/browse_thread/thread/0f2d2558e372898c

you should be able to see what's wrong.

Btw, for future posting, two comments:

1) Please post your sessionInfo() and additional information that you
might think can help us troubleshoot.

2) Please start a new thread with a descriptive subject line when your
question is different from your previous one. That way one can browse
the 'Discussions' section for help as well;

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/topics

Cheers

Henrik
